title: 質疑応答の切り返し
note: 聞き返す・お礼を言う・答えられないときにかわす・図に戻るなど、質問への最初のひと言。定型句は Wordvice「研究発表の質疑応答対処法」の英文を収録し、質問例・場面・訳は架空の研究にもとづくオリジナル。

decks.title: 質問を受ける・お礼を言う

refs.name: Wordvice: 研究発表の質疑応答対処法

cards.scene: 発表が終わり、これから質疑応答に入る
cards.q: Thank you for your talk. Are there any questions from the audience?
cards.ja: ご発表ありがとうございました。会場から質問はありますか。
cards.frame: I will now answer any ... Please speak ...
cards.en: I will now answer any questions you have about this research. Please speak slowly and clearly.
cards.more: I am also happy to hear your comments.

cards.scene: 良い質問をもらった。まずお礼を言う
cards.q: Why did you choose a smartwatch rather than a phone?
cards.ja: なぜスマホではなくスマートウォッチを選んだのですか。
cards.frame: That's a great ... Thank you for ...
cards.en: That's a great question. Thank you for asking.
cards.more: We chose a smartwatch because people wear it all day.

cards.scene: 答えにくい質問を、丁寧に受け止めてから答える
cards.q: Have you thought about privacy?
cards.ja: プライバシーについて考えましたか。
cards.frame: I appreciate your question and am ...
cards.en: I appreciate your question and am happy to answer it.
cards.more: Yes. All data is processed on the device and never sent to a server.

cards.scene: よく考えられた質問をもらった
cards.q: Could your method also help older adults who live alone?
cards.ja: あなたの手法は一人暮らしの高齢者にも役立ちますか。
cards.frame: What a thoughtful ...! I'm glad ...
cards.en: What a thoughtful question! I'm glad you asked.
cards.more: We think so. That is one of the main uses we have in mind.

cards.scene: 想定していなかった面白い質問をもらった
cards.q: What would happen if two people shared one watch?
cards.ja: 2人で1つの時計を共有したらどうなりますか。
cards.frame: What an interesting ...! I'll do my best ...
cards.en: What an interesting question! I'll do my best to answer.
cards.more: The model would probably get confused, because it learns each user's way of moving.

cards.scene: 大事な指摘をもらった
cards.q: Isn't the sample size too small to say that?
cards.ja: そう言うにはサンプル数が少なすぎませんか。
cards.frame: Thank you. That's ...
cards.en: Thank you. That's an important point.
cards.more: I agree that ten people is small. We are now collecting data from fifty more.

cards.scene: 質問というより意見（コメント）をもらった
cards.q: I think this could also work for sports. Have you thought about that?
cards.ja: これはスポーツにも使えると思います。それについて考えましたか。
cards.frame: Thank you for the ... That's a ...
cards.en: Thank you for the comment. That's a good idea.
cards.more: We have not tried sports yet, but it would be interesting to test.

decks.title: 聞き取れない・分からないとき

refs.name: Wordvice: 研究発表の質疑応答対処法

cards.scene: 質問が速くて、よく聞き取れなかった
cards.q: Have you checked how much battery the app uses when it runs all day on older phones?
cards.ja: 古いスマホで一日中動かしたとき、アプリがどれだけ電池を使うか確認しましたか。
cards.frame: Sorry, I didn't ... Could you ..., please?
cards.en: Sorry, I didn't catch all of that. Could you repeat your question, please?
cards.more: Thank you. So you are asking about battery use on older phones.

cards.scene: 聞き取れたが、何を聞かれているのか分からない
cards.q: How does your work fit into the bigger picture of context in computing?
cards.ja: あなたの研究は、コンピューティングにおけるコンテキストという大きな枠組みにどう位置づけられますか。
cards.frame: I'm afraid I don't ... Could you please ...?
cards.en: I'm afraid I don't understand. Could you please rephrase the question?
cards.more: I see. So you mean how our work relates to other context-aware systems.

cards.scene: どの研究のことを聞かれているのか、はっきりしない
cards.q: How is this different from the earlier study?
cards.ja: これは以前の研究とどう違うのですか。
cards.frame: I don't quite ... Are you asking about ...?
cards.en: I don't quite understand. Are you asking about the earlier study on step counting?
cards.more: If so, the main difference is that we use only one sensor.

cards.scene: どの数値のことか、はっきりしない
cards.q: Is that number the same for all the groups?
cards.ja: その数値はすべてのグループで同じですか。
cards.frame: Are you referring to ...?
cards.en: Are you referring to the accuracy in Figure 3?
cards.more: If so, that is the average. Each group is shown on the next slide.

cards.scene: どの参加者のことか、はっきりしない
cards.q: Did those people also wear the watch at night?
cards.ja: その人たちは夜も時計を着けていましたか。
cards.frame: Do you mean ...?
cards.en: Do you mean the participants in the control group?
cards.more: If so, yes. They wore it day and night, like the other group.

cards.scene: 質問が漠然としていて、何から答えればいいか分からない
cards.q: What about the real world?
cards.ja: 実環境ではどうですか。
cards.frame: Could you be ...?
cards.en: Could you be more specific?
cards.more: For example, are you asking about noise, or about different kinds of users?

cards.scene: 言い換えてもらっても、まだ分からない
cards.q: No, I mean the other part. How does it connect to the whole thing?
cards.ja: いえ、もう一方の部分のことです。それは全体とどうつながるのですか。
cards.frame: I'm sorry. I still don't ... Could I ...?
cards.en: I'm sorry. I still don't understand your question. Could I come back to you later?
cards.more: I would like to think about it a little.

cards.scene: やはり分からないので、セッションの後で話したい
cards.q: Do you see what I mean about the two parts?
cards.ja: 2つの部分について、私の言っていることが分かりますか。
cards.frame: Could you please talk to me ...?
cards.en: I'm sorry, not yet. Could you please talk to me after the session?
cards.more: I would like to understand your point and answer it properly.

cards.scene: 最後の部分だけ聞き取れなかった
cards.q: And how many of them used the app every day after the study ended?
cards.ja: そして、研究が終わった後、そのうち何人が毎日アプリを使いましたか。
cards.frame: Sorry, I missed ... Could you say ...?
cards.en: Sorry, I missed the last part. Could you say that again?
cards.more: Ah, after the study ended. About half of them did.

cards.scene: もう少しゆっくり言ってほしい
cards.q: Have you thought about combining the motion data with location data from the phone?
cards.ja: 動きのデータとスマホの位置データを組み合わせることを考えましたか。
cards.frame: Could you say that ..., a little more ...?
cards.en: Could you say that one more time, a little more slowly?
cards.more: Thank you. Combining motion and location is a good idea. We have not tried it yet.

decks.title: 時間をもらう・中身を確かめる

refs.name: Wordvice: 研究発表の質疑応答対処法

cards.scene: すぐには答えが出ない。質問の一部を繰り返して、考える時間をもらう
cards.q: Were all sample groups in the study in the same cohort?
cards.ja: 研究のサンプルグループはすべて同じコホート（同時期に集めた集団）でしたか。
cards.frame: ...? Please give me a moment to ...
cards.en: In the same cohort? Please give me a moment to think about this question.
cards.more: Yes. All of them joined the study in the same month.

cards.scene: 答える前に少し考えたい
cards.q: Would the results change if the sensor were on the other wrist?
cards.ja: センサーを反対の手首に着けたら、結果は変わりますか。
cards.frame: Just one moment—I need to ...
cards.en: Just one moment—I need to consider my answer.
cards.more: I think the results would be a little lower, because people move their main hand more.

cards.scene: 分析のことか実験のことか、確かめてから答える
cards.q: Can you explain how you checked that?
cards.ja: それをどうやって確かめたのか説明してもらえますか。
cards.frame: Just so I understand, are you referring to ... or to ...?
cards.en: Just so I understand, are you referring to the methods of analysis or to the experiment?
cards.more: If you mean the analysis, we tested the model on users it had never seen.

cards.scene: どの研究と比べているのか確かめる
cards.q: How do your results compare with the study from last year?
cards.ja: あなたの結果は昨年の研究と比べてどうですか。
cards.frame: Do you mean ...?
cards.en: Do you mean the field study from 2025?
cards.more: If so, our accuracy is a little lower, but we use far fewer sensors.

cards.scene: 何の情報のことか分からない
cards.q: Where does that information come from?
cards.ja: その情報はどこから来ているのですか。
cards.frame: What information are you ... exactly?
cards.en: What information are you referring to exactly?
cards.more: If you mean the sleep labels, they come from a sleep diary.

cards.scene: 質問の一部を繰り返して、どのデータのことか確かめる
cards.q: What about the data collected between 2019 and 2021?
cards.ja: 2019年から2021年の間に集めたデータについてはどうですか。
cards.frame: ...? Which data are you ... exactly?
cards.en: The data collected between 2019 and 2021? Which data are you referring to exactly?
cards.more: We collected both sensor data and survey answers in those years.

cards.scene: 質問を自分の言葉で言い直して確かめる
cards.q: Does it still work when people do two things at once?
cards.ja: 人が同時に2つのことをしていても、それはうまく動きますか。
cards.frame: So your question is ..., right?
cards.en: So your question is whether it can detect two activities at the same time, right?
cards.more: Good point. Right now it gives only one label at a time.

cards.scene: 少し考える時間がほしい
cards.q: What would you change if you had ten times more data?
cards.ja: データが10倍あったら、何を変えますか。
cards.frame: Let me think about that for ...
cards.en: Let me think about that for a second.
cards.more: I think we would try a larger model and test it on more kinds of users.

refs.name: Wordvice: 研究発表の質疑応答対処法

cards.scene: 答えが分からない
cards.q: What about the data collected before the app update?
cards.ja: アプリの更新前に集めたデータについてはどうですか。
cards.frame: I'm sorry. I'm afraid I don't ...
cards.en: I'm sorry. I'm afraid I don't know the answer to that question.
cards.more: I will check it and send you an email.

cards.scene: 今は分からないが、調べて後で連絡する
cards.q: Does the same thing happen with other brands of watches?
cards.ja: 他のメーカーの時計でも同じことが起きますか。
cards.frame: I will look into ... and follow up ...
cards.en: I will look into that and follow up with you.
cards.more: Could I have your email address after the session?

cards.scene: 今は答えられないが、調べてみる
cards.q: How much would it cost to use this in a whole hospital?
cards.ja: 病院全体でこれを使うと、費用はどれくらいかかりますか。
cards.frame: I can't answer now, but I will ...
cards.en: I can't answer now, but I will try to find out more about this.
cards.more: We have only tested the cost for a small group so far.

cards.scene: この場では答えたくない（セッションの後で話したい）
cards.q: Is your lab planning to sell this system?
cards.ja: あなたの研究室はこのシステムを販売する予定ですか。
cards.frame: I'm sorry—could we discuss ... after ...?
cards.en: I'm sorry—could we discuss this issue after the session?
cards.more: I am happy to talk about it then.

cards.scene: この場では答えたくない（個別に話したい）
cards.q: When is the latest version of this study going to be published?
cards.ja: この研究の最新版はいつ発表されますか。
cards.frame: I'd rather discuss ... privately, ...
cards.en: I'd rather discuss this issue privately, please.
cards.more: Please come and talk to me after the session.

cards.scene: 答えるための情報が手元にない
cards.q: Has anyone reported skin problems from wearing the sensor for weeks?
cards.ja: 何週間もセンサーを着けて、肌のトラブルを報告した人はいますか。
cards.frame: We aren't aware of ... at this time.
cards.en: We aren't aware of any details at this time.
cards.more: No one in our study reported it, but we did not ask about it directly.

cards.scene: 答えるための情報がまだない
cards.q: What are the findings of other research groups on this issue?
cards.ja: この問題について、他の研究グループではどんな結果が出ていますか。
cards.frame: We don't have ... yet. We are awaiting ...
cards.en: We don't have information about this yet. We are awaiting further research on this.
cards.more: I would be glad to hear about it if you know any.

cards.scene: 答えるには、自分たちの追加の研究が必要
cards.q: Does this also work for children?
cards.ja: これは子どもにも使えますか。
cards.frame: We need to do ... to answer this.
cards.en: We need to do more studies to answer this.
cards.more: So far, all of our participants were adults.

cards.scene: 答えるには、他の研究の結果を待つ必要がある
cards.q: Is it safe to wear the sensor every night for a year?
cards.ja: 1年間毎晩センサーを着けても安全ですか。
cards.frame: We are awaiting ... on this issue.
cards.en: We are awaiting further research on this issue.
cards.more: For now, we only know about a few weeks of use.

cards.scene: 自分の専門の外の質問
cards.q: How would this work under European privacy law?
cards.ja: ヨーロッパのプライバシー法のもとでは、これはどうなりますか。
cards.frame: That's outside ..., so I ...
cards.en: That's outside my area, so I'm not sure.
cards.more: But I think keeping the data on the device would help.

cards.scene: 確かではないので、推測だと断って答える
cards.q: Would it work with a cheaper sensor?
cards.ja: もっと安いセンサーでも動きますか。
cards.frame: I'm not sure, but I think ...
cards.en: I'm not sure, but I think it would work with slightly lower accuracy.
cards.more: We have not tested it, so this is only a guess.

decks.title: 手法への質問に答える

refs.name: Wordvice: 研究発表の質疑応答対処法

cards.scene: 提案された手法は使っていない。提案にお礼を言う
cards.q: Have you used this approach?
cards.ja: このアプローチを使ったことはありますか。
cards.frame: No, but thank you for ... We will ...
cards.en: No, but thank you for your input. We will look into this.
cards.more: It sounds useful for our next study.

cards.scene: 検討したが、問題があって使わなかった
cards.q: Have you considered using a camera instead?
cards.ja: 代わりにカメラを使うことは検討しましたか。
cards.frame: We considered this approach. But there were ...
cards.en: We considered this approach. But there were some problems.
cards.more: For example, cameras raise privacy concerns at home.

cards.scene: 選んだ理由を順に述べる
cards.q: Why did you use this method of analysis?
cards.ja: なぜこの分析手法を使ったのですか。
cards.frame: There were several reasons for this. First, ...
cards.en: There were several reasons for this. First, it works well with small data.
cards.more: Second, it is easy to explain to doctors.

cards.scene: 他の手法には問題があった
cards.q: Why didn't you use a newer deep learning model?
cards.ja: なぜもっと新しい深層学習モデルを使わなかったのですか。
cards.frame: We found several other methods to be ...
cards.en: We found several other methods to be problematic.
cards.more: Most of them needed much more labeled data than we had.

cards.scene: 理由は論文に詳しく書いてある（要点だけ言う）
cards.q: Why did you design the experiment this way?
cards.ja: なぜ実験をこのように設計したのですか。
cards.frame: We have explained our ... fully in the paper.
cards.en: We have explained our rationale fully in the paper.
cards.more: In short, we wanted to test the system in normal daily life.

cards.scene: 限界を挙げる
cards.q: What limitations to the study did you identify?
cards.ja: 研究の限界として何を特定しましたか。
cards.frame: We did identify a couple of limitations. These include ...
cards.en: We did identify a couple of limitations. These include the small number of participants.
cards.more: Also, all of them were university students.

cards.scene: 検証した範囲では、特に限界は見つかっていない
cards.q: Were there any limitations in your setup?
cards.ja: 実験環境に何か限界はありましたか。
cards.frame: We didn't identify any specific ...
cards.en: We didn't identify any specific limitations.
cards.more: But we only tested it in one building, so we will check other places.

cards.scene: 設定値（パラメータ）を選んだ理由
cards.q: Why did you use a five-second window?
cards.ja: なぜ5秒の窓を使ったのですか。
cards.frame: We tried ..., and ... worked best.
cards.en: We tried several lengths, and five seconds worked best.
cards.more: Shorter windows missed slow activities, and longer ones were too slow to respond.

cards.scene: ベースラインとの比較を聞かれた
cards.q: Did you compare your method with a simple baseline?
cards.ja: あなたの手法を単純なベースラインと比較しましたか。
cards.frame: Yes, we compared it with ...
cards.en: Yes, we compared it with a simple threshold method.
cards.more: Our method was about fifteen points better.

decks.title: 結果・応用への質問に答える

refs.name: Wordvice: 研究発表の質疑応答対処法

cards.scene: どの結果について聞きたいのか確かめる
cards.q: Could you elaborate on the results of the second experiment?
cards.ja: 2つ目の実験の結果について詳しく説明してもらえますか。
cards.frame: Yes. What results would you ...?
cards.en: Yes. What results would you like to know about?
cards.more: For example, I can talk about accuracy or about how users felt.

cards.scene: 未発表なので、結果について今はこれ以上話せない
cards.q: Could you tell us more about the results with the new users?
cards.ja: 新しいユーザーでの結果についてもっと教えてもらえますか。
cards.frame: I'm afraid I can't say more about ... now.
cards.en: I'm afraid I can't say more about the findings now.
cards.more: The paper is still under review.

cards.scene: いちばん大事な意味を述べる
cards.q: What are the implications of these findings?
cards.ja: これらの発見はどんな意味を持ちますか。
cards.frame: Most importantly, these findings imply that ...
cards.en: Most importantly, these findings imply that one sensor can be enough.
cards.more: This makes the system cheaper and easier to wear.

cards.scene: 意味がいくつかあるので、順に述べる
cards.q: What do these results mean for app developers?
cards.ja: これらの結果はアプリ開発者にとってどんな意味がありますか。
cards.frame: There are several implications here. First, ...
cards.en: There are several implications here. First, apps can save battery by using fewer sensors.
cards.more: Second, they can work without an internet connection.

cards.scene: 意味（影響）について、今はこれ以上話せない
cards.q: What do these findings mean for your industry partner?
cards.ja: これらの発見は、提携企業にとってどんな意味がありますか。
cards.frame: I'm afraid I can't say more about ... now.
cards.en: I'm afraid I can't say more about the implications now.
cards.more: We are still discussing it with our partner.

cards.scene: 他の分野への影響を述べる
cards.q: Could this study impact any other related areas of research?
cards.ja: この研究は他の関連分野に影響を与えうるでしょうか。
cards.frame: These results might impact areas of ...
cards.en: These results might impact areas of healthcare and elderly care.
cards.more: For example, they could help find changes in daily routines early.

cards.scene: 判断するには情報が足りない
cards.q: Could this also be useful for sports science?
cards.ja: これはスポーツ科学にも役立ちますか。
cards.frame: We need more information to ...
cards.en: We need more information to answer this question.
cards.more: Athletes move much faster than our participants did.

cards.scene: 結論が言えるのはこの分野の範囲だけ
cards.q: Would the same conclusion hold for factory workers?
cards.ja: 同じ結論は工場の作業者にも当てはまりますか。
cards.frame: Our conclusions are limited to ...
cards.en: Our conclusions are limited to this area of research.
cards.more: Factory work would need a new study.

cards.scene: 結果から言えることを控えめに述べる
cards.q: So does this prove that your method is better?
cards.ja: では、これはあなたの手法の方が優れていることを証明しているのですか。
cards.frame: Not exactly. It suggests that ...
cards.en: Not exactly. It suggests that our method works better in this setting.
cards.more: We need more data to make a general claim.

cards.scene: 意外だった結果について聞かれた
cards.q: Were you surprised by any of the results?
cards.ja: 結果の中で意外だったものはありますか。
cards.frame: Yes. We were surprised that ...
cards.en: Yes. We were surprised that sleep detection worked so well.
cards.more: We expected it to be the hardest activity.

decks.title: スライド・図に戻って答える

refs.name: Wordvice: 研究発表の質疑応答対処法

cards.scene: 発表の中ですでに話した内容
cards.q: Could you repeat what methods of analysis you used?
cards.ja: どんな分析手法を使ったか、もう一度言ってもらえますか。
cards.frame: As I mentioned earlier, ...
cards.en: As I mentioned earlier, we used a random forest.
cards.more: It was trained on data from ten users.

cards.scene: スライドを戻して説明し直す
cards.q: Could you go back to your system overview?
cards.ja: システムの概要に戻ってもらえますか。
cards.frame: Let's look at this ... again.
cards.en: Let's look at this slide again.
cards.more: The watch sends data to the phone, and the phone runs the model.

cards.scene: スライドの番号を示して答える
cards.q: Which sensors did you use again?
cards.ja: どのセンサーを使ったんでしたっけ。
cards.frame: Yes. Looking at slide ..., ...
cards.en: Yes. Looking at slide 5, we used only the accelerometer.
cards.more: We did not use the heart rate sensor.

cards.scene: 図に戻って確かめながら答える
cards.q: Are the data in Figure 4 representative of all sample groups?
cards.ja: 図4のデータはすべてのサンプルグループを代表していますか。
cards.frame: Let's take a look at this ... again.
cards.en: Let's take a look at this figure again.
cards.more: This figure shows only the first group. The others were similar.

cards.scene: 図表を指しながら説明する
cards.q: What is being measured in Table 2.2?
cards.ja: 表2.2では何を測定しているのですか。
cards.frame: As you can see in this ..., ...
cards.en: As you can see in this table, we measured accuracy for each activity.
cards.more: The last column shows the average.

cards.scene: グラフをもう一度説明し直す
cards.q: I didn't follow the graph on the results slide. Can you explain it?
cards.ja: 結果のスライドのグラフが分かりませんでした。説明してもらえますか。
cards.frame: Let me explain this ... again.
cards.en: Let me explain this figure again.
cards.more: The x-axis is the time of day, and the y-axis is the number of steps.

cards.scene: 聞かれたことを説明するスライドがある
cards.q: How did the users feel about wearing the watch?
cards.ja: ユーザーは時計を着けることをどう感じていましたか。
cards.frame: I have a slide on that. Let me ...
cards.en: I have a slide on that. Let me show you.
